        if (d1 + shift) % 7 == d2:
            possible = True
            break

    if possible:
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

import sys

def solve():
    days = ["monday", "tuesday", "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday"]
    day_to_idx = {d: i for i, d in enumerate(days)}
    
    # Days in each month for a non-leap year
    month_days = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    
    # Calculate the shift in day of week from the 1st of month i to the 1st of month i+1
    # Shift = (days in month i) % 7
    shifts = []
    for i in range(11):
        shifts.append(month_days[i] % 7)
    
    # Read input
    try:
        line1 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        line2 = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    except ValueError:
        return

    if not line1 or not line2:
        return

    d1_idx = day_to_idx[line1]
    d2_idx = day_to_idx[line2]
    
    # Calculate required shift
    # (d1 + shift) % 7 == d2  =>  shift == (d2 - d1) % 7
    required_shift = (d2_idx - d1_idx) % 7
    
    # Check if this shift exists in our precomputed shifts
    if required_shift in shifts:
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
